data.description:
## What
Write a structural test verifying that the RECALL_RESULT signal contract document exists and has the required top-level sections.

## Why
Behavioral Testing Standard Rule 5: non-executable markdown files require section-heading structural checks (^## SectionName), not body-text grep. The contract doc is a non-executable instruction artifact; its structural boundary must be testable.

## Test file
tests/test-inference-recall-replay.sh (same file as T1-T3)

## Test cases
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inference-recall-result.md exists
- Section '## Signal Name' present
- Section '## Emitter' present
- Section '## Output Schema' present
- Section '## SC4 Gate Semantics' present

## Acceptance criteria
- Tests fail (RED) before the contract doc is created
- Uses section-heading grep (^## SectionName), not body-text content checks
data.title: RED: test inference-recall replay contract doc exists with required sections
